WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , 1 AS __order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __valid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END AS __payment_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __refund_cents
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_11.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_11.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_18.avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value
  , MAX(subq_18.refund_amount_rate) AS refund_amount_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__order_count) AS order_count
    , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2024-09-02' AND '2024-09-02'
) subq_11
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__valid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_order_value
    , CAST(SUM(__refund_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__payment_cents), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_amount_rate
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2024-09-02' AND '2024-09-02'
) subq_18
